+import java.lang.reflect.Method;
...
+    increment(context.getCounter(Counts.CORRUPT));
```
Reason:
The patch introduces an alternative implementation for incrementing counters by using reflection to invoke the `increment` method on the `Counter` class. This allows the continuous verification process to increment counters without relying on the now-removed `CounterUtils` class, thus restoring the intended functionality.
